text: Pellet, Alla hino Yamira on nde Yottinton kala halfinaɗon e hoolaare faade e jeyɓe nde, Himo Yamira on kadi nunɗugol tuma ñaawoton hakkunde yimɓe ɓen hara on ooñaaki e ñaawoore nden. Pellet, ko Alla Waajorta on kon e kala huunde laamaa. Pellet, Alla Laatike Nanoowo haalaaji mon, Reenuɗo golle mon.
